exposures.mechanism_hypothesis: The fund holds large retailers and the manufacturers that supply them, so a dispute over who bears a cost moves value between its holdings and can leave the fund little changed. A shock to the whole chain, such as weaker household income, does not cancel in this way.
Creations and redemptions are primary-market activity in this fund; they do not by themselves establish net flows into the group.
